source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
This approach and timeline sound great, Nolan, so let’s move forward.

The first step should cover:
• system layout
• motor + component selection
• basic wiring plan

From there, the goal is to get a working prototype running as quickly as possible and refine it afterward. Tell me what information you need from me to begin.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: Power for the electronics comes from a 120v-to-12v 35A DC supply, with each station using its own PWM speed controller. At each station, a 12v 450rpm motor connects through a 1/2" shaft coupling to a 1/2" stainless steel shaft, which drives the wire whisk for mixing and frothing the matcha. The electronics are actively cooled by 80mm fans. In the plumbing system, every 4.5 quart stainless steel bowl has a 3/8 barb outlet, where a #5 silicone stopper creates a press-fit, leak-proof connection. From the barb union inside that stopper, 3/8 silicone tubing runs to the 1" ght adapter, which threads directly onto the push-style beverage spigot.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer provides an initial electrical-system overview describing the power supply, independent controllers, motors, and cooling-fan connections.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: We're aligned on the scope of the next milestone. Understood, Elena.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Elena, apologies for the slow response over the past week; I’ve been focused on finalizing your build. The food-contact materials are in good shape: every area that touches liquid is made from stainless steel, and the silicone components are food grade. The enclosure uses PETG plastic, which is considered food safe even though the enclosure never contacts the liquid.

Parts can be accessed easily if anything needs to be replaced or swapped. Cleaning the internal plumbing may be slightly more difficult than cleaning the rest of the machine, but rinsing it after each use and occasionally running a bottle brush through the lines should be sufficient.

I’ve also saved all of the documentation, including the CAD files, materials, Bom, and wiring overview.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports that the wiring overview has been saved with the project documentation.
